title: Orange5 Commitment Atom v0
description: AtomSmasher Commitment Atom — smallest unit of operator-or-system-promise. Compresses a decision, commitment, invariant, deadline, or threshold into a deterministic, hash-chained, verifiable atom. Atoms are append-only; an atom cannot be edited, only superseded by a new atom whose 'supersedes' includes the old atom's id. Persisted as JSONL in Reality lane via Æ Cobra Flux writer (origin='atomsmasher', kind='commitment') AND in a SQLite index for fast queries.

atom_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest uniquely identifying this atom. Computed deterministically over canonical-JSON of (kind, body, preconditions, supersedes, evidence, created_at, sovereign, actor, signature.prev_hash).

kind.description: Classification of the promise this atom encodes.

body.description: Typed payload of the atom. Shape depends on 'kind'; consumers SHOULD validate against the per-kind body sub-schema, but this top-level schema only enforces that body is a non-empty object.

preconditions.description: Ordered list of atom_ids that MUST be 'active' or 'fulfilled' for this atom to be considered valid. Empty array if none.

supersedes.description: Ordered list of atom_ids this atom replaces. The named atoms transition to status='superseded'. Empty array if this is a net-new commitment. The only lawful way to 'edit' an atom is to supersede it.

evidence.description: Paths (POSIX-style, relative to Orange5 repo root or absolute file URIs) to receipts, test outputs, JSONL records, or other artifacts proving the atom. Required even for purely declarative atoms — at minimum the Flux JSONL line that recorded this atom.

signature.description: Hash-chain signature linking this atom to its predecessor. 'prev_hash' is the atom_id of the previous atom in the same lane, or the 64-char zero string for the genesis atom. 'hash' equals atom_id (duplicated here so the signature object stands alone for verification).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset. RFC 3339 profile (e.g. 2026-06-24T14:32:17.482Z).

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiration. After this instant the atom SHOULD be transitioned to status='revoked' by a sweeper if not already 'fulfilled' or 'superseded'. Null or omitted means no expiration.

sovereign.description: The human sovereign on whose authority this atom is recorded. For Orange5 this is always 'Atom McCree'.

actor.description: The system, agent, or human writer that produced this atom record. Examples: 'atomsmasher', 'orangellm', 'aeons-lead', 'human:atom'.

lane.description: Optional lane tag for the Reality writer (e.g. 'commitment', 'decision-log'). If present, MUST be a kebab-case identifier.

tags.description: Optional free-form labels for indexing. Each tag is kebab-case, <=64 chars, deduplicated.
